items.t: Power window regulators fail
items.job: Replace one window regulator
items.note: RepairPal puts a G550 window regulator at about $1,330-1,480 per door.

items.t: Door locks and door handles stop working
items.job: Replace one door lock actuator
items.note: RepairPal estimate is about $430-560 per door. A broken outer handle is a separate part.

items.t: Front axle swivel seals leak and wheel bearings wear
items.job: Front axle service: wheel bearings, swivel seals and kingpin bearings
items.note: One owner was quoted about $4,000 for a full front axle service.

items.t: Worn suspension bushings, ball joints and shocks
items.job: Replace suspension bushings, ball joints and shocks
items.note: Owners report about $1,000 in parts for bushings and ball joints and about $3,000 at a shop. Dealer shocks run about $1,000 each; aftermarket ones far less.

items.t: Oil leaks from the valve covers and oil pan
items.job: Replace or reseal the oil pan
items.note: RepairPal puts a G550 oil pan replacement at about $700-880. Valve cover gaskets are a separate, usually smaller job.
